game.title: Resident Evil Requiem
game.blurb: Survival horror game, the ninth main Resident Evil, from Capcom, released 2026-02-27. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The campaign from start to finish, following Grace and Leon. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Difficulty and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing on Casual, Standard (Modern) and Standard (Classic), and a run with no healing items.

chapters.title: Survival: Items, Locks and Upgrades
chapters.summary: The item box, lockpicks, the supply box, weapon upgrades and crafting every item with Leon.

chapters.title: Combat
chapters.summary: Parrying, throwing dropped weapons, hatchet finishers, the Requiem and defeating 300 enemies.

chapters.title: Mr. Raccoon, Files and Extras
chapters.summary: Destroying every Mr. Raccoon memoriam, reading every file, and viewing all models and concept art.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 3764200)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (residentevil.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://residentevil.fandom.com/wiki/Resident_Evil_Requiem
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result, "resident-evil-9-requiem" (id 1004511, named "Resident Evil 9: Requiem", released 2026-02-27, Capcom), matches the expected slug. No StrategyWiki page under "Resident Evil Requiem" or "Resident Evil 9: Requiem". residentevil.fandom.com answers the API under "Resident Evil Requiem", with at least 500 linked pages (the API's one-page limit; more remain, mostly cast and credits), including subpages "/plot", "/gameplay" and "/notes", and "Grace Ashcroft" and "Leon Scott Kennedy"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 3764200 is "Resident Evil Requiem". 30 of 49 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Ten of them have high unlock rates (72 to 94%) in a falling run ("Déjà vu" to "Hope and Requiem") and look like story steps; others with low rates (16 to 24%, for example "Speed Demon", "Minimalist", "Remarkable Agent") may be challenge runs, but their conditions are secret, so they were not moved. Which character the combat goals belong to is not stated, except "as Grace" (item box) and "with Leon" (crafting).
